subject.title: fix(ci): keep new OpenClawKit suite off frozen targets

question: Should the CI owner accept the exact `OpenClawKit tests` workflow-step marker as the compatibility capability for frozen release-validation targets?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes trusted release-validation orchestration for historical targets, and the protected maintainer routing requires an owner to confirm that this marker is the durable compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the capability marker
options.body: Confirm that the named workflow step is the intended target-owned capability signal, then refresh the branch and merge after the current-head checks pass.

options.title: Use a different explicit capability
options.body: If workflow-step names are not considered stable compatibility markers, replace the probe with an owner-approved versioned signal and update the manifest guards.

recommendation.title: Accept the capability marker
recommendation.body: Confirm that the named workflow step is the intended target-owned capability signal, then refresh the branch and merge after the current-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the CI orchestration proposal and can coordinate the intended compatibility contract with the CI area owners.
